features.quote: Maximum 25 turns (sufficient to trigger degradation, low enough to manage inference costs).
features.justification_quote: low enough to manage inference costs

features.quote: If `Action_Entropy < 0.2` for 3 consecutive turns OR `Apology_Count > 3` in the last 5 turns -> Halt run. Mark as "Spiraled."
features.justification_quote: This prevents burning compute on a model that has already broken down.
